status: FROZEN INTAKE ONLY: no method may run until each task has a source-data receipt, an answer proxy transcribed from the publication, and a canonical protocol hash. This file deliberately does not inherit v02 outcomes.
purpose: Create a fresh retrospective panel of public paired H&E/spatial-transcriptomics studies. These cohorts are excluded from all concept fitting, normalisation fitting, learned-search meta-training, development selection, and blind-discovery analyses.

common_rules.input: The method sees the data and a broad pre-publication scientific target, not the published answer variables or relation.
common_rules.selection: Task wording, answer proxies, direction, spatial transform, candidate pools, split, budget, and scoring rule must be written and hashed before any MORPHEUS or baseline output is viewed.
common_rules.patient_split: All slides from a patient stay together; a deterministic patient-disjoint support/query split is predeclared in the task-specific frozen protocol.
common_rules.output: Keep full ranked lists, candidate counts, query-side gain and all misses. Historical results are not used for tuning.
